newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 2.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:

* Time Warner chairman Gerald Levin said the company will finalise deals to bring in an outside partner for New Line Cinema and sell off some cable interests by year-end. Levin also said News Corp's $2 billion satellite-TV joint venture with EchoStar Communications DISH.O is a "form of intimidation" whose "true objective is to get distribution on cable of the Fox (programming) services."
* High production costs and soaring star salaries do not appear to be deterring studios from spending on costly films.
* Walt Disney's ABC tied with General Electric's NBC in March 24-30 primetime Nielsen results.
* Quentin Tarantino and producer Lawrence Bender are in final negotiations with Samuel Jackson, Pam Grier and Bridget Fonda to star in "Jackie Brown" for Miramax.
* President Clinton requested the Federal Communications Commission investigate the effects of broadcast alcohol advertising on children.
* A civil court jury awarded writer-director Ron Shelton $9.82 million for compensation due, but never paid, under the terms of his former deal with News Corp's 20th Century Fox.
* Alfonso Arau will co-write and might direct the futuristic epic "Metabarons," now in development at Universal with Addis-Wechsler's Nick Wechlser and Arau producing.
